title: KarcherIndex
abstract: A Lean 4 formalization of the Morse index and nullity of Karcher saddle towers, formalizing results from arXiv:2608.13451v2. For the Enneper-Weierstrass realizations, the two-period quotient Xi_{k,2} has index 4k-3 and bounded Jacobi-field nullity 3 for every k >= 3. For the six-ended family Xi_{3,m}, every positive integer m has index 6m-4 floor(m alpha*)-3 and nullity 7 when m alpha* is an integer, and 3 otherwise. The same threshold alpha* lies in (1/3,1/2), with certified strict bounds 0.4323617 < alpha* < 0.4323619. As in the paper, index and nullity are defined using complex-valued functions, with dimensions taken over the complex numbers. The development constructs realizations from the explicit data and supplies the geometric-to-analytic identifications, rather than assuming the existence of a realization. Supporting results include proper embeddedness and the equivalence of boundedness and finite Dirichlet energy for smooth geometric Jacobi fields on the finite period quotients.
